resources.string: Gather your group around one phone. Pass it from hand to hand. Each player reveals their fate in secret, then passes it on. A chime sounds every time it changes hands.
The Honest all see the same secret word: the Truth. Keep it to yourself.
One player (or more, in bigger groups) is the Trickster and does not know the Truth. The Trickster may hear a Whisper: a hint that can be easy, medium or hard to use.
Going around the circle, everyone says one word linked to the Truth. The Honest must prove they know it without giving it away. The Trickster must blend in. Lie well.
Debate, accuse, defend. Then the group chooses one player to banish.

Banish the Trickster and it\'s Mischief found! Banish one of the Honest and the Trickster prevails. With more than one Trickster, the Judgement goes on until every Trickster is banished, or the Tricksters equal the Honest in number. With the optional rule \"The Trickster\'s last lie\", a banished Trickster can still win by guessing the Truth.
Players, Tricksters, categories and Whispers will be chosen here.
Sound and reveal style will be set here.
